title: Cohomological boundedness of the localizing exceptional object
statement:
Fix a universe u, a prime $\ell$, and a field $k$ in universe u of positive
characteristic different from $\ell$. Let $Z,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes
and let $g:Z\to Y$ be a proper $k$-morphism [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\Lambda$ be one of the following three commutative condensed coefficient rings,
with its specified multiplication: $\underline E$ for a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$,
$\underline{\mathcal O_E}$ for its valuation ring, or the finite-subextension-valued
ring $\underline{\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell}$ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring;
sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed].
For $T=Z,Y$, put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$, let $D_T=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T})$
be the ordinary unbounded module-object derived category
[sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], let $\mathcal B_T$ be its bounded constructible
full subcategory [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], and let
$\mathcal L_T=\operatorname{Loc}(\mathcal B_T)$ be the full localizing hull, using
ambient coproducts indexed in universe u+1
[def-sfb-bounded-constructible-localizing-closure].
Let $F_g:\mathcal L_Z\to\mathcal L_Y$ be the canonical restriction of the ambient
$Rg_*$ [lem-sfb-adic-proper-localizing-pushforward]. For every functor $G:\mathcal L_Y\to\mathcal L_Z$, every supplied adjunction $F_g\dashv G$, and every $K\in\mathcal B_Y$, there exist integers $a\le b$ such that $H^i((G(K)).\mathrm{obj})=0$ for all integers $i$ with $i<a$ or $b<i$. Here $K$ is included into $\mathcal L_Y$ by the canonical full inclusion, and the homology is computed in the ordinary ambient module-object derived category. No choice of a right adjoint is part of the assertion.

lean.statement: theorem ellAdic_localizing_rightAdjoint_obj_isBounded (G : (boundedConstructibleLocalizingClosure Λ Y.left).FullSubcategory ⥤ (boundedConstructibleLocalizingClosure Λ Z.left).FullSubcategory) (adj : ellAdicLocalizingLowerStar Λ ℓ g hΛ ⊣ G) (K : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ Y.left)).FullSubcategory) : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, (i < a ∨ b < i) → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj ((G.obj ((boundedConstructibleToLocalizing Λ Y.left).obj K)).obj))

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-N6-a2b0bfa17 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the whole item, the parent, the ancestor, the unit record and every cited statement, plus det-existence-restriction.proof.md, Stacks 01T6, Bhatt–Scholze Def 6.8.10 and Prop 6.8.11, Mathlib Adjunction/Unique.lean:102-133, and the live Lean IsEllAdicCoefficient and padicAlgClRingObj (EllAdic.lean:161-235). Statement: positive characteristic is now explicit, matching the parent, the setting and the Lean Fact (ringChar k).Prime. The three coefficient rings are listed directly; they are exactly the three constructors of the Lean certificate, and the Qbar ring is the finite-subextension ring. The worker's counterexample showing it differs from all continuous maps is correct. Nothing is weakened. Proof steps: (1) Z and Y are Noetherian and qcqs, and the subspace-Noetherian argument holds. (2) and (3) show the general-lfp and constant-model constructibility predicates agree, through the E/Qbar lfp bridges on Noetherian strata and the integral comparison, which allows torsion. (4) B_T equals Dbc equals Dctf in D(Mod_{Λ_T}) by ctf-equals-bc clause (2); the two hulls are the same intersection, with the universe u+1 consistent with def-weil-size-convention. (5) H = g^! of sk-prop-sf-existence; clause (1) of det-cor-existence-ii gives Rg_! ≅ F_g; sk-thm-restriction and int-brown-adjoint plus sk-thm-int-restriction give H(K) in Dctf. This is the blueprint route. (6) The supplied adjunction is transported along α and rightAdjointUniq gives G ≅ H on the whole hull. (7) The vanishing bounds transfer across that isomorphism. Edge cases K=0, Z empty, g=id and torsion O_E/ℓ are fine. No new nodes; proof_deps equals the union of the uses; no SGA. Accepted tool_uses: the two lfp bridges, the integral comparison and ctf-equals-bc; the pbc scheme lemmas are Mathlib leaves. For maintenance: the wording of (iii) in def-sfb-adic-coefficient-certificate, 'C(-,Qbar)', should read the finite-subextension ring, as in its citation and the Lean.
